content: A journey of a thousand miles begins beneath your very feet.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Qian li zhi xing, shi yu zu xia (千里之行，始于足下) — Dao De Jing Ch. 64
explanation: The most intimidating expedition across mountains and continents is not conquered by a superhuman leap, but by the humble, rhythmic placement of one foot before the other. Do not fear the vastness of the horizon; master only the immediate step in front of you.
practicalInsight: Focus on the next five minutes rather than the next five years. Complete the single task right in front of you.
reflectionPrompt: What grand journey have you postponed simply because you were too intimidated by the distance to take step one?
